title: Resolve an annotation authored before its endpoints
preconditions: A fresh Saga has neither the referenced prototype nor story revision.

steps.action: Author an element annotation pinned to prototype r1 and story s1; load/compose it, then create those exact endpoints and compose again.
steps.expected_result: The unresolved annotation remains loadable with two gaps; resolution makes it current, linked and covered with bidirectional annotation identity.

steps.action: Read the annotation record and compare its prototype revision, story revision and element selector with the authored values.
steps.expected_result: All explicit pins and selector values are retained exactly.

expected_result: Resolve an annotation authored before its endpoints.
